prompt: Create ONE individual complete-character 2D fighting-game sprite, polished cel shading with crisp dark contours, coherent with Digital Circus Encore. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, external glow, particles, text, logo, watermark, inset or duplicate. One original static game adaptation; do not copy the product scene or its squat toy proportions. Reference 1 is the APPROVED SELECTION SEED: strictly preserve its identity, proportions, colors, exact anatomy and polished 2D style. Reference 2 supplies the official product details only. Make a genuinely different pose, never a mirrored or cropped copy of selection. DESIGN LOCK: ONE entire Bowling Pin Ragatha: familiar pale cloth Ragatha head with RED YARN HAIR, large BLUE BOW, one BLUE BUTTON EYE and the other normal eye with mauve eyelids, small triangular nose and friendly stitched-doll smile. Her ONLY BODY is a complete WHITE/VERY PALE GRAY BOWLING PIN with white pointed collar and rectangular PERIWINKLE PATCHES. POSE: LOW DEFENSE facing screen RIGHT: low diagonal lean of the whole bowling-pin character, blue-bowed head dipping forward and the continuous pin body slanting behind it. The body never bends into a humanoid torso or knees; no new anatomy.

observations: Low defense is expressed by slanting the whole pin and lowering the head, without a human torso, knees or additional appendages.
